scope: 32 authored preference requests, exact single expected asset, three rotated option orders. Role-only oracle intent; actual host interpretation measured separately. Development set, not independent acceptance.
limitations: Oracle intent isolates asset preference; strict real parser coverage is reported separately.
No STT or browser paint included.
32 authored cases repeated three times are not 96 independent examples.

All 32 query vectors are warmed before any arm and reported separately; percentiles measure the same warm query-cache condition. Arms run sequentially, so timing remains descriptive, not an isolated causal speed claim.
Rotated-order diagnostic calls are separate from actual ranked runtime decisions.
